title: T06 Planning and Reflection Data Contract
description: SQLite table contract. All timestamps are UTC ISO 8601 strings ending in Z. Calendar dates are Seoul-local date strings.

timezone.overdue_rule: A task is overdue when status is todo and due_date is earlier than today's Asia/Seoul calendar date. A completed task is never counted overdue.

snapshot_json.description: Immutable full plan snapshot immediately before an update.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion. Deleted tasks are excluded from lists and review calculations.

review_calculations.cohort: Tasks whose non-deleted parent plan overlaps the selected date range (plan.start_date <= range.to and plan.end_date >= range.from).
review_calculations.task_count: Count of cohort tasks, equivalent to non-deleted tasks attached to the matching plans.
review_calculations.completed_count: Count of cohort tasks where current status is done.
review_calculations.overdue_count: Count of cohort tasks where current status is todo and due_date is non-empty and earlier than Asia/Seoul today.
review_calculations.blocked_count: Count of distinct cohort tasks with at least one execution record whose blocker_reason is non-empty after trimming.
review_calculations.estimated_minutes: Sum of estimated_minutes for cohort tasks.
review_calculations.actual_minutes: Sum of actual_minutes for all execution records attached to cohort tasks.
review_calculations.difference_minutes: actual_minutes - estimated_minutes; unit minutes; empty sums are zero.
review_calculations.completion_idempotency: Each completion attempt has a UUID idempotency key that is unique in execution_records. Status change and record insertion happen in one SQLite transaction. A retry with the same key or a repeated request while the task is already done does not add a second record. After reverting the task to todo, a later intentional completion uses a new key.
